notes.notes:
Hope - Update 1.9 Patch Notes

notes.title: Update 1.8v
notes.notes:
Hope - Update 1.8 Patch Notes
https://i.imgur.com/SLD2X1c.png

Animation Changes
- Updated drink usage animation.

Model Changes
- Improved bullet casing model.

UI Changes
- Updated Credits UI.

Gameplay Features
- Quick item switching added  
- Key binding now saves  
- Crosshair is now always visible and circular  
- Gore effects upgraded  
- Expanded Player Config options (adjust XYZ scale and position)  
- Ejected casings now have improved physics  
- PKP can now cause dismemberment  
- PKP fire rate changed (0.07 → 0.06)  
- Bullet impact force increased (3000 → 6000)  
- AI behavior tree updated  
- AI perception logic improved  
  - Before: AI detected all enemies in their vision  
  - After: AI reacts even if just one enemy is seen (faster response)  
- Button click sound updated
https://i.imgur.com/6MGlhqa.png

Bug Fixes
- Fixed ammo bug for AA-12 (ammo would reset to 30 when dropped and picked up again)  
- Fixed bug where player couldn’t stand while holding shield in crouch  
- Fixed bug where player became stuck after exiting ragdoll  
- Fixed zombie duplication bug

Map Updates
- Trench map reworked  
- Forest map foliage render distance adjusted
https://i.imgur.com/J3vzjU0.png

Message from the Developer

I'm now shifting focus toward mod support and occasional bug fixes.  
Why? Because I’m starting a new project!  
I once made a psychological horror game, and I plan to rebuild it from scratch.

But don’t worry — this doesn’t mean I’m abandoning Hope.  
After mod support is complete, bug patches will continue,  
and if multiple developers come together in the future,  
Hope 2 is something I’d seriously consider.
https://i.imgur.com/DNfXCwS.png

notes.title: Update 1.7v
notes.notes:
Hope - Update 1.7 Patch Notes

1. Gameplay Features

1. Fixed the slow-motion feature in Playground Mode.  
2. Added key binding options.  
3. Added durability to body armor.  
4. Increased inventory space.  
5. Added collision sounds for ragdoll bodies.  
6. Added sound effects to UI buttons.  
7. Added new stat tracking.  
8. Improved gore system.  
* When an arm is severed, blood will now also appear on the upper part.  
9. Characters now scream upon death.  
10. Adjusted bullet gravity values.  
11. Fixed issue where AI checked every frame whether the target was dead.  
12. Added a Credits section to the menu.  
13. Improved AI healing logic.  
* AI now heals when their current health is below 100%.  
14. Each AI now has a different turning speed.  
15. Animation speed is now based on movement speed.  
16. Added new ragdoll types.  
* Animation-based ragdoll / basic ragdoll  
17. Added collision sounds when dropping items.

2. New Items

- Body Armor Repair Kit  
- Energy Drink  
* Increases movement speed by 1.4x upon use

3. Follow Development on Discord

▶ Join our official Discord server

notes.title: Update 1.2.5v
notes.notes:
Hope - Update 1.2.5 Patch Notes

1. Quality of Life Improvements

You can now preview map images and descriptions before starting the game  
Fixed issue where the new Wire Action model collided with the player  
Improved AI logic for picking up items  
Pressing F now plays a sound  
Picking up or dropping weapons now triggers a sound effect

2. New Maps

- Added a map with multiple pillars  
- Added a very wide and flat map

3. Bug Fixes

- When AI dies and drops a weapon, it will now be removed properly in Playground Mode when the delete button is pressed  
- Added missing key binding descriptions in the settings menu

4. Visual Updates

Reduced the length of the rope in Wire Action to minimize excessive swinging

notes.title: Update 1.2v
notes.notes:
Hope - Update 1.2 Patch Notes

1. Improvements & Changes

AI Behavior Improved  
Wire Action model updated  
Weapon physics system revamped  

Weapons can now be dropped and picked up (by both players and AI) To Press "G" 
* AI will switch to a dropped weapon if it’s better than their current one.

Most maps now include grass and trees  
New Melee Weapon Added: "Spear"  
* The longest and most powerful melee weapon in the game (as of Update 1.2).

New confirmation popup appears when opening external links  
Playground Mode: You can now see AI movement points on the map  
* AI chooses one randomly and moves toward it.

2. Coming in the Next Update

- AI will take cover behind structures  
- AI will be able to use mounted weapons  
- New maps: Apartment, City, and a new one for Playground Mode

3. Join Our Discord

Want to follow development or receive important news?  
Join our official Discord server

4. A Message from the Developer

Originally, "Hope" was designed as an open-world territory war game.  
The idea was to fight across vast land, loot, build shelters, and capture regions like in real wars.  
But developing such a large-scale game solo proved too difficult.  
That’s why it transformed into the immersive simulation FPS it is today.

If there's an opportunity in the future, I plan to release an open-world territory war DLC for about $2~3.  
And although no one had purchased the game when I was preparing this update...  
If you’re reading this because you bought the game — thank you so much. I’ll keep working hard.

notes.title: Update 1.1v
notes.notes:
New Game Mode - Playground
You can now create your own battles by spawning or deleting AIs from a spectator perspective.
You can check game time, camera speed, and AI information. The game time feature is still under development and will be improved in future updates.

Improved Sensitivity Settings
Spectators now also follow the sensitivity setting values.

Zombie Item Improvement
Spawns a clone similar to yourself, but without body armor or headgear. The model is replaced with a fixed zombie model.

AI Improvements
Some AI functions have been slightly modified.

Friendly Fire
A new friendly fire option has been added to the settings.

Translation Improvements
Minor adjustments have been made to the Korean language.

Filter Adjustments
The main menu filters have been improved.
